title: Streams
explain: A stream processes a collection as a pipeline: filter, transform, then collect a result. Operations like `filter` and `map` are lazy and only run when a terminal operation such as `toList` or `sum` is called. Streams don't change the original collection.
exercise: From a list of numbers, keep the even ones, square them, and add up the result with a stream.
tip: A stream can be used only once. Reusing it throws `IllegalStateException`, so create a fresh stream from the collection.
